elenchusLines: 245-256 (single-item Elenchus; the cut then runs into the Hoeschelius and Schottus prefaces)

entries.author: PHOTIUS CONSTANTINOPOLITANUS PATRIARCHA
entries.title: Myriobiblon sive Bibliotheca (codd. 1-249)
entries.note: Elenchus prints 'col.' with no number (the whole Elenchus is this one item). Body: the Bibliotheca proper opens with its Greek/Latin title block at line 2413, page 41/42 (header '4i BIBLIOTHECA 42' line 2379); Ordo reads 42 for 'Bibliotheca sive Myriobiblon' and for the Epistola Photii ad Tarasium. An earlier general title page (same Greek/Latin title, line 262-266) precedes Hoeschelius's nuncupatory epistle at col 9 (Ordo 9) and Schottus's at col 14; Prolegomena at cols 17-39 (Ordo 19), with Index auctorum at col 29 (Ordo 31) and Index codicum MSS at col 39 (Ordo 42). Codex I (Theodorus presbyter) follows at col 42; Codex CCXLIX at col ~1579 (line 121326), volume ends col 1596. Greek and Latin side by side; codices are not given separate Elenchus columns, so the single entry stands.

problems: Elenchus lists a single item with no column number; no agree/disagree test possible, the body and Ordo give col 41/42.
Codices I-CCXLIX are not itemised (not Elenchus items); Ordo columns for them are noisy and were not used.

Ordo-only apparatus not entered: Epistola Hoeschelii nuncupatoria (Ordo col 9), Epistola alia Schotti nuncupatoria (14), Eruditorum aliquot de Photio judicia (14), Index alphabeticus auctorum Bibliothecae Photianae (Ordo 31), Index codicum Mss. (Ordo 42). The Ordo's Codex I-CCXLIX lines are chapters of the Bibliotheca, not separate works.
